title: Conclusion data for normalized finite-free scalar calculus
statement: Let C be an essentially small site in the universes of the constant-module sheaf derived categories [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category, def-weil-pbc-derived-categories], J its topology, and A and B commutative rings with an A-algebra structure and a specified finite basis of B indexed by Fin r. Ordinary extension E is sheafified postcomposition by B tensor_A -, with its scalar adjunction, and U is ordinary scalar restriction [def-pc-sheaf-restrict-scalars]. FiniteFreeScalarDescent packages exactness of E and U, the universal exact derived descent, the localized scalar adjunction with its explicit unit and counit factorizations, conservativity of derived U, the natural finite-basis biproduct decomposition pinned by its inclusions, and preservation of K-flatness [def-pc-kflat-complex]. FiniteFreeScalarTensorCalculus adds a sheaf balancing isomorphism U(EM tensor_B N) to M tensor_A UN with its two pure-tensor formulas. FiniteScalarDerivedTensorModels packages the corresponding natural derived isomorphism with its homogeneous-summand and localization-tensorator normalization. For arbitrary properties bcA and bcB of the two derived categories, FiniteFreeScalarCalculus adds this derived comparison, preservation of bcA into bcB, and preservation of each Tor interval tested against all degree-zero module sheaves [def-weil-finite-tor-amplitude]. These are conclusion structures over fixed existing functors and tensor products, with no selected data from existence theorems.
